Synthesize a dry sandy subterranean grinding rumble, with audible 180-500 Hz grit so it reads on small speakers. Add slow irregular pressure swells, no bass-only effect, explosive eruption or constant tonal note. Warning identity should be clear in the first 150 ms. Deliver 1 distinct take, each 3 seconds long including decay. Make the entire file a seamless repeat with constant ambience or musical continuity at the join; no audible restart, baked fade, extra reverb tail or added silence. No intelligible words, dialogue sentences, music, background ambience or unrelated actions. Use original recordings or synthesis; do not sample reference games, copy recognizable character voices, or imitate a named performer. Export WAV, signed PCM 16-bit, 44.1 kHz, mono, peak no higher than -1 dBFS. Judge short sounds by peak and perceived loudness; do not force an integrated LUFS target. Exact whole-file cyclic edit; no head/tail fades or padded silence baked into the loop. Wrap reverb/noise decay across seam.
